subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined phrase/idiom.

Losing my job turned out to be __a blessing in disguise__, as it pushed me to pursue my passion and start my own successful business.

options.text: something one can gift to others
something which is a hidden danger
something unfortunate that results in an unforeseen positive outcome

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrase **"blessing in disguise"** refers to something that initially seems unfortunate or negative but ultimately leads to an unforeseen positive outcome. (छुपा हुआ वरदान) • **Example:** Losing my job turned out to be a blessing in disguise, as it pushed me to pursue my passion and start my own successful business. • **Unforeseen Positive Outcome** means a result that was unexpected and beneficial. (अप्रत्याशित सकारात्मक परिणाम) • **Example:** Missing the train might have been a blessing in disguise, as I avoided the accident that happened on that route. • Hence, the correct meaning of "blessing in disguise" is **"something unfortunate that results in an unforeseen positive outcome."** Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: Something one can gift to others** (कुछ ऐसा जिसे दूसरों को उपहार स्वरूप दिया जा सकता है): Refers to an object or gesture that can be given as a gift. • **Example:** Flowers are something one can gift to others as a token of appreciation. • **Option 2: Something which is a hidden danger** (ऐसा कुछ जो एक छुपा हुआ खतरा है): Refers to a situation or element that poses a risk but is not immediately apparent. • **Example:** The slippery road was a hidden danger that caused several accidents. • **Option 3: Something which shows compassion** (कुछ ऐसा जो करुणा दिखाता है): Refers to an act or gesture that conveys kindness and empathy. • **Example:** Helping the homeless is something which shows compassion. 2f:Tc36, The correct answer is: **Dull**.
